subject: general
question: According to India State Forest Survey Report 2021, the forest cover in India is _______ of the geographical area of the country.
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.62%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The whole **geographic area **that the government has designated as a **forest **is known as **forest cover**.
 
• India's total forest cover as of **2021 **was **80.9 million hectares** or **24.62 percent **of the country's total land area.
 
• Over **2019**, there has been an **increase **in the forest cover of about** 1,540 sq. km.**
 
• According to the area, **Madhya Pradesh **has the **most forest cover**, followed by **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• When compared to the whole geographic area, **Mizoram **has the **greatest proportion **of forest cover.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The country's **forest cover **and **tree cover **are updated in the India State of **Forest Report **2021.
 
• The first survey was released in **1987**, and they are now issued **every two years**.
 
• The** Forest Survey of India's 17th edition **of **ISFR **is currently available (FSI).
 
• The India State of Forest Report 2021 is used for **planning **and **policy development **in the** forestry, agroforestry, and forest management** sectors.
 
• Three categories of forests exist:
 
 
• **Very dense forests **(canopy density - 70%)
 
• **Moderately dense **forests (40-70%)
 
• **Open forests **(10-40%).
 
 
 
• Although not classified as **woods, scrubs **(canopy density less than 10%) are also surveyed.
